propositions: MCP reference generator selects only the first physical line, causing wrapped registrar prose to yield truncated summaries instead of complete first paragraphs.
The transition_ticket registrar description does not accurately document close-class behavior for bug vs. non-bug tickets.
Generated MCP summaries must preserve Markdown table pipe characters by escaping them as \| to prevent table corruption.
Complete first-paragraph summaries must be extracted by normalizing wrapped lines and stopping before subsequent paragraphs.
The generator introduction must accurately describe that summaries are first paragraphs rather than first lines.
The transition_ticket registrar must document all 12 bug classifications, four supported non-bug administrative subsets, and the ignore-close-class rule for non-closing transitions.
